digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified Gate / CI voting workflow
propositions: A cancelled or timed-out mutation job casts Verified -1 with a message 'CANCELLED: <url>' that names neither the job nor the reason, providing no triage signal to distinguish timeout from test failure or stale-base version skew.

The gerrit-review-action hardcodes its message template and exposes no input for custom text, so failure detail cannot be enriched in the vote message itself and must be posted as a separate comment-only review.

A new summarize_ci_failures.py script maps GitHub check-run jobs and annotations to a per-job summary (TIMED OUT vs CANCELLED vs FAILED with duration and link), filtering out successful jobs and escaping hostile job names.

The gerrit-verify.yaml vote job adds a summarize step fetching jobs and annotations via GitHub API, then posts the summary via SSH gerrit review with no label, running continue-on-error after the vote is cast so a fault cannot fail the gate.
